what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Senegal in Mauritania: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 601 Senegalese asylum seekers in Mauritania, 1.5% of all asylum seekers from Senegal.
Refugees from Senegal, a separate group, live mostly in France, Gambia, Canada and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Casamance territory in Senegal with the MFDC in 2011.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2023 to 2025, come long after that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 14 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Mauritania.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Mauritania only.
